questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go to different cities. Both the big ones, Milan, Rome, Venice, Florence and the smaller, Ravenna, Modena, Rimini, etc. Bologna is really well-connected with public transportation and if you book long time in advance you can save a lot on train tickets.

questions.answer: Italians can be quite closed off.

questions.answer: Have patience with documentation, be open to meeting new people and sign up for couses offering Italian

questions.answer: Seeing a lot of art and movies, because Bologna is a really good cinema-city
